title: Refine Lighthouse Puzzle: Scroll-Wheel Steering, Dynamic Fog Realtime Contact, Grounded Stone Pedestal and Top-Lantern Beam
description: Critical polish for lighthouse puzzle in PlayScene2 based on playtest feedback & screenshots: increase beam thickness and brightness, implement dynamic fog/gate response that returns when beam wanders off the sensor, ground the wheel and socket on a stone pedestal on the island floor beside the lighthouse entrance, emit beams directly from the high lantern room at the summit of the towers, and map steering to the mouse scroll wheel.
acceptance_criteria: Light beams are visually prominent (width 0.85m - 1.15m) with bright emission and contact hit marker.
Marsh fog and watermill boom dynamically respond to beam contact: clears when hitting sensor, re-thickens if beam wanders off before boat passes.
Steering wheel and socket pedestals are firmly planted on the stone island floor beside lighthouse doors (y ~ 1.3m - 1.7m), with zero mid-air floating.
Beams emit directly from the top lantern rooms at the summit of both lighthouses (y ~ 7.56m - 9.0m).
Scrolling mouse wheel up/down rotates the active lighthouse beam smoothly.
LevelTwoValidation passes cleanly with all new adjustments.
test_command: Unity Editor MenuItem: 'Hold My Hand/Level 2/Wire Beacons Watermill and Victory'
risks: Ensure sensor collider strictly bounds the jewel lens sphere so hits require actual visual alignment.
Ensure mouse scroll delta handles both smooth and notched mouse wheels.
